convite: Join a community that wants to unite the Gospel message with care for people. Together we can build initiatives for food, clothing, education and welcome, respecting each person’s dignity.

frentes.descricao: Building initiatives so that more people can access food, clothing, footwear and everyday essentials.
Bringing together resources and people willing to support learning, reflection and character formation for children, young people, adults and older people.
Working with institutions and professionals to develop support for people in vulnerable situations, including those experiencing homelessness.
Receiving invitations for talks, visits and gatherings in other cities, planning each participation together.

partilha: Sharing means recognizing someone with the same dignity as our own. We want to turn faith and resources into care: food that is missing, needed clothing, an opportunity to learn and a welcoming presence. Each partnership can begin with one possible gesture, made with responsibility, respect and transparency.
etapas: Tell us who you are and which community or institution you represent.
Describe the idea, the need and the city where you would like the activity to take place.
Let us discuss possibilities, responsibilities and next steps.
